== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Flagship Operations (V) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. '''Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text.''' The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB3-30-Flagship_Operations.png]]), the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB3-D-flagshipoperations-pre.gif]]) and the Master List slip (2013) show the original words (see [[Flagship Operations (V)]]).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured 21 July 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html); 11 December 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205219/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html); 11 January 2013 (https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html); also on the Virtual master list (VMasterType) to 11 January 2013. The list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data. Typos, capitals and punctuation are kept as published; icons the list writes out in words are drawn as the printed slip draws them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on a system. Your TIEs may relocate (as a regular move) to a system from 0 to 3 parsecs away. For each battleground system you control with two TIEs piloted by Imperials, you may add 3 to your total power in battles. Opponent’s Force drain is +3 here. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, set mark, slip label and copyright line as printed) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>.spec.json</code> next to the image in the batch R8-U run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
